name: Netorare Kanojo ~Gifu no Nikubou o Kuwaekomu, Ai Suru Ore no Kanojo~
original_name: 寝取られ彼女 ～義父の肉棒を咥え込む、愛する俺の彼女～
source: An old childhood friend comes back to town and the protagonist starts dating her, but her step-father has other plans for her...
translation: 一位老青梅竹马回到镇上，主人公开始和她交往，但她的继父对她另有企图……
